title: fitting hooks to a display panel

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: How many hooks should I put on this panel?
turns.zh: 這塊展示板上要裝幾個掛鉤？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: A. The hooks are made of steel. B. I'll bring you a drill. C. Two should be enough.
turns.zh: A. 掛鉤是鋼製的。 B. 我拿一支電鑽給你。 C. 兩個應該就夠了。
